findings.title: release-branch coverage check drops legacy v1 rules.yml fallback
findings.body: skills/release-branch/SKILL.md and REFERENCE.md now read coverage thresholds exclusively from `advisory.quality_gates.coverage` in a version-2 rules.yml, with no fallback to a top-level `quality_gates` block. runtime/src/config/rules_schema.rs still explicitly recognizes top-level `quality_gates` as valid legacy-v1 advisory metadata (BlockEnforcement::LegacyV1, warning not error in non-strict mode), and scaffold/templates.rs is the only place version is pinned to 2 for brand-new projects, so an existing target project that has not yet migrated to the v2 schema would now have its release blocked unconditionally ('Missing or invalid thresholds block release') even though the runtime still accepts its config as valid. This appears to be a deliberate, narrow scoping decision matching the approved 516-spec.md MC-01 text ('resolves advisory.quality_gates.coverage from the active version 2 configuration'), so it is raised as a non-blocking, low-confidence observation rather than a defect against this patch's own acceptance criteria.
